Hammarby Fotboll, more commonly known as Hammarby IF or simply Hammarby, is a Swedish professional football club from Stockholm founded in 1915. The club plays at 3 Arena in Johanneshov but was founded in the neighbouring Södermalm district of Stockholm City Centre, an area that is considered the club's heartland.
